# While

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
While condition
statements
Wend
```

## Description

Runs the statements as long as the condition is true, testing it before each pass. When the condition is false at the start, the statements never run. The loop ends with [Wend](Wend).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 3
While n > 0
	Print n
	n = n - 1
Wend
```

```text
3
2
1
```

## Related Commands

[Until](Until), [Wend](Wend)
